data.text: prime says 'Merged 1 change from another branch, no conflicts' when nothing was merged. countIncoming (src/core/snapshot.ts:247) counts events newer than the cached boundary by any other actor as incoming, so events a different actor wrote in the same working tree since the last rebuild read as a merge. Reproduced while recording the site demo: ana wrote tasks with >/dev/null, git user.email switched to ben, ben's first prime reported a merge. Same shape for a person and an agent with its own KADENCE_ACTOR in one checkout. Not fixed: October is fixes named by pilots or conversations only (strategy D3).
